Question Q-5178: What day of the week was 2022-03-17?

Answer: Thursday

Calculation: January 1, 2022 was a Saturday. January has 31 days, February 2022 had 28 days (not a leap year). March 1, 2022 was a Tuesday. March 17 is 16 days after March 1, and 16 mod 7 = 2, so Tuesday + 2 = Thursday.
